comment: Rendered literals in apps/web/src that are intentionally NOT translated (#906, #909): format and tech names, brand and license names, unit and stat abbreviations, placeholder examples, and identifiers that only look like copy (fallback usernames, download basenames, decorative alt text). Add here only when a string is genuinely locale-invariant; UI copy belongs in packages/shared/src/i18n. An entry written as path::text applies only to that file (repo-relative); use it for generic words like admin or image so the same word elsewhere is still reported (#977).
